ticket.summary: Burst braided supply hose under kitchen sink sprayed ~2-3 min; customer closed both fixture shutoffs per PB-01 so leak is now CONTAINED (downgraded from S1 intake to S2) - kitchen sink out of service pending supply line replacement.
mitigation_advice: Closed both hot and cold fixture shutoff valves under the kitchen sink (clockwise until snug) - spray stopped [PB-01]
Keep both valves closed and do not use the kitchen sink until the tech arrives [PB-01]
Dry out the cabinet and floor with towels/fan overnight to limit mildew
If water sprays again, shut the house main and call us [PB-02]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, and you did great tonight - catching those valves fast saved you a lot of damage. Booked: Mon Sept 1, 8:00 AM - 48 Union Ave, Apt 2. Job: kitchen sink supply line replacement, $129 flat rate (~45 min). Keep both under-sink valves closed until we arrive, and towel/fan the cabinet tonight. If anything starts spraying again before then, shut your house main and text us right away.
